thread:
Anna CSM: Heads up — Orca Systems goes into pilot next Wed (USA/EU/APAC overlap). They need a temporary egress allowlist + short-term rate lift for the demo window. Also want APAC region routing enabled for a small % of traffic. Can ops/net/eng confirm what's feasible and any config snippets we should hand to the customer? :eyes:
Carlos Net: Got it. Please share the source CIDRs and expected ports. We can add to the firewall and our edge ACLs. Typical ask: add TTL 3d auto-revoke.
Anna CSM: CIDRs coming from Orca (they said 34.85.120.0/22 and 13.229.0.0/16 for the pilot). Ports 443 only. Demo window: 2026-04-01 14:00–16:00 UTC. Expected sustained QPS =~120, spikes up to 350 for ~20–30m.
Tom Ops: We can do a temporary rate lift on the hosted tier and enable burst policy. I'll create a policy and tag it with "orca-pilot-2026-04-01". Ops note: need approval for >2x baseline qps on eu/sg edges.
Maria CS: Customer is in the onboarding success path but flagged renewal risk in 3 months — they want to see stable latency during pilot before committing. Important to avoid 5xx or token-throttle during demo.
Sanjay ML: If cost is a concern we can route non-critical requests to a quantized variant during the spike. Recommend model-routing rule: if latency SLO > 200ms or token costs > threshold, route to redwood-q4-small. Keeps responses similar for demos.
Carlos Net: Here's a minimal allowlist snippet we can push to the edge config (will auto-expire):
```
- name: orca-pilot-allow
  cidrs:
    - 34.85.120.0/22
    - 13.229.0.0/16
  ports: [443]
  expires_at: 2026-04-04T14:00:00Z
```
I'll open a change with infra and request EM approval.
deploy-bot: Deployment validation: edge-acl/orca-pilot-allow created in staging. No conflicts. (check-id c3f9-orp) :white_check_mark:
Tom Ops: For rate config, suggest temporary route config: `rate_window: 60s; baseline: 120rps; burst: 400rps; autorevoke: 2026-04-01T18:00:00Z`. I'll set alerting: >250rps sustained for 5m triggers paging to ops.
Maria CS: Can we also add a per-account soft quota increase so they don't hit a hard cap during the demo? If ops needs a PO/commit to approve permanent lift, let's scope this as a temporary promo window.
Priya AM: FYI I'm on the renewal thread. If the demo goes well we'll move to dedicated next qtr. Please capture perf numbers (p50/p95 latency, errors, cost per 1k tokens). I can share with the execs.
Anna CSM: Next steps: Carlos to push ACL + confirm ports, Tom to set rate window and soft quota for orca-account-id O-98321, Sanjay to add a model-routing fallback rule to reduce cost during spikes, Maria to prep enablement doc for the customer (quick checklist + warmup tokens). I'll coordinate a dry-run on Tue 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC.
Carlos Net: ACK. I'll post the change PR and the CIDR proof-of-possession link once it's in infra.
Tom Ops: ACK, will attach runbook and escalation matrix to the policy.
Sanjay ML: Added a canary routing rule to staging with sample config. Will push to prod after dry-run.
Maria CS: I'll send the enablement checklist to Orca's SRE and schedule warmup. Template includes KV cache warmup, prefix caching, and sample prompts.
Anna CSM: Thanks all — priority: avoid any throttles or 5xx during the demo. Tagging @Priya AM for renewal visibility. :sparkles:
